auth.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, at most 72 bytes.

login.title: Sign in to {site}
login.description: Use your email and password, a passkey or a linked account.
login.luogu: Sign in with a linked Luogu account

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Your account asks for a one-time code to finish signing in.

luogu.title: Sign in with Luogu
luogu.description: Works only for CP OAuth accounts that already have this Luogu UID linked.
luogu.uidHint: The number in your Luogu profile URL.
luogu.uidRule: A Luogu UID contains digits only.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Your username is public. You can change it later.
register.usernameRule: 3–24 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
register.exists: An account with this username or email already exists.
register.verificationSent: Account created. We sent a link to verify your email.
register.closedText: The administrator isn't accepting new accounts right now. If you already have one, sign in.

description.luogu: Prove you own a Luogu account with a public clipboard. Your CP OAuth account starts with it linked.
description.leetcode: Prove you own a leetcode.cn account through its bio. Your CP OAuth account starts with it linked.

uidHint.luogu: The number in your Luogu profile URL.
uidHint.leetcode: The part after /u/ in your leetcode.cn profile URL.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the email address of your account. We'll send a reset link valid for 30 minutes.
forgot.sentText: If {email} belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: After the reset, all sessions are signed out and you sign in again.
reset.doneText: Sign in with your new password to continue.
reset.invalidText: Reset links expire after 30 minutes and work once.

verified.successText: For your security, sessions were signed out. Sign in again to continue.
verified.expiredText: Request a new verification email from your profile.
verified.conflictText: Another account confirmed this email address first. Your previous address is unchanged.
verified.errorText: It may have been used already. Request a new verification email from your profile.
